20. HTTP vs TCP vs IP

HTTP defines application messages, TCP provides reliable byte transport, and IP routes packets
between networks.
HTTP එක request/response rules Jදෙනවා. TCP එක bytes reliably Jගනයනවා. IP එක packets
An HTTPS API request is carried over TCP/IP in HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2.

Q: Can HTTP run without TCP?
A: Yes. HTTP/3 runs over QUIC on UDP.
